ModMetaData.name: True Child Aging
ModMetaData.author: HopeSeekr
ModMetaData.description:
Version 1.0.0 Replaces RimWorld's child-aging factor with an integer slider from -5x to 5x (default 4x, matching vanilla).
1x to 5x: children age at this speed (vanilla is 4x). From 11 to 20 they gradually slow to the adult rate. 0x: freeze biological aging only while it is ahead of chronological age; when they meet, both tick 1:1. -1x to -5x: reverse biological aging toward chronological age; when they meet, both tick 1:1.
Requires Harmony and Biotech. Changes apply immediately; no restart needed.
